## Checklist (every PR)

- [ ] Tests pass (`pytest -q`)
- [ ] README updated: roadmap table/status, routes, settings, behavior this PR changes
- [ ] Issues: `Closes #N` for finished ones; a comment on partly-done ones; new issues for follow-ups, in the right milestone
- [ ] Infra: `terraform plan` noted if `infra/` changed (apply before or with the deploy)
